platformCalibration.sectionBasis: 27 observed/mapped park steps constrain sunken atrium section; platform assembly lowered rigidly by5m to retain plausible main-bank slope. Not a surveyed elevation.

authoredInterior.routeSummary: Mapped Burrard Street entry → unpaid glass atrium → main triple bank → platform-level faregates → upper Waterfront platform; separate short stairs/escalator → lower outbound platform. Mapped lift house has its own street gates.
